text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria rejects World Bank proposals to carry out massive privatisation of state-owned enterprises.
- President Liamine Zeroual visits Bahrain to boost bilateral cooperation.
- Arab police and security officials are to adopt recommendations to fight terrorism and crime on Wednesday at the end of their three-day congress in Algiers.
- Echourouk newspaper manager Mokrane Hamoui assassinated in Algiers.
- Home-made bomb kills three, wounds 13 in the northeastern town of Lakhdaria.
